---
title: "Flow"
output: html_document
---


``` {r Flow models}
## Flow
Flow_monthly <- Flow_Data %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(time),
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Year, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Flow_mean = if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_ else mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate the historical distribution for each station and month, excluding ReportYear. 
# This gives us the typical monthly HISTORICAL conditions
Flow_historical <- Flow_monthly %>%
  filter(Year >= 1977, Year <= ReportYear - 1) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Historical_mean = mean(Flow_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_sd = sd(Flow_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_low = quantile(Flow_mean, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_high = quantile(Flow_mean, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Isolate ReportYear value
Flow_current <- Flow_monthly %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear) %>%
  select(StationCode, Month, Flow_current = Flow_mean)

# combine the two tables
Flow_comparison <- Flow_historical %>%
  left_join(Flow_current, by = c("StationCode", "Month")) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = Flow_current - Historical_mean,
    Anomaly = Difference / Historical_sd
  )

# Flow Figure
FlowFigure <- ggplot(Flow_comparison, aes(x = Month)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = Historical_low,
      ymax = Historical_high
    ),
    alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Historical_mean),
    linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Flow_current),
    linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(y = Flow_current),
    size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ StationCode) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Stream Flow (ft³/s)",
    title = "2025 Stream Flow Compared with Historical Conditions",
    subtitle = "Historical period: 1977–2024; shaded area represents the 10th–90th percentile") +
  
  theme_classic()

FlowFigure



```
